package.description: DMX lighting controller that records, stores, and plays back lighting shows.

en-US.description: DMX lighting controller that records, stores, and plays back lighting shows.
en-US.longDescription: DMX Core 100 records lighting shows from your lighting software, stores them, and plays them back on schedules or on demand. Playback can be triggered from the built-in web interface, schedules, the Web API, or external protocols such as OSC, MQTT, MIDI, and Stream Deck. Output goes over sACN, Art-Net, and KiNet. This desktop edition runs the same software as the DMX Core 100 wall-mounted appliance.
en-US.name: DMX Core 100
